data_scope: 9 FX pairs, 782 canonical weekends 2011-07..2026-07, 1m mid OHLC
primary_metric: per-event mean fade R, weekend-clustered t
result_summary: NO-GO on the preregistered spec. k=1.5/d=5/h=1440: mean R +0.531, clustered t=+1.85 (P1 FAIL). P2 8/9 pairs positive PASS, P3 AUDJPY +0.692 PASS, P4 retention 0.54 PASS, P5 gross +9.3 pips PASS. Validity gate passed but the reported MDE was wrong (see EXP-0002).
notes: Data-quality finding: USDJPY/NZDJPY/EURJPY archives carry synthetic weekend bars in 2021-23; a canonical EURUSD session calendar is imposed on all pairs.

hypothesis: Weekend gap mean reversion on 9 FX pairs (discovery follow-up at the 1-hour horizon)
kill_test: Discovery cell must survive delayed entry, weeknight placebo, gap-sign null, and reopen-spread cost
primary_metric: mean fade R hold-from-entry; max|t| vs gap-sign-randomised null
result_summary: Reversion is REAL but not tradable and not weekend-specific. H=60min k=1.5: mean R +0.292, t=+4.22, 9/9 pairs positive, sign-null frac 0.0000 (real max|t| 5.94 vs null p95 2.86). But weeknight placebo carries 62% of it (+0.181), era-unstable (2019-22 ~0), and gross +3.97 pips vs a 1.5-8.75 pip reopen range: break-even round-trip ~4 pips. Corrected two EXP-0001 defects (MDE double-counted the real effect; delay control shortened the hold).
notes: Discovery, not confirmatory: the 1-hour horizon was chosen after seeing the EXP-0001 surface.
